title: Payer Quantity Allowances for Blood Glucose Testing Supplies
content:
The Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program covers test strips within a rolling 90-day allowance that depends on the tier and on how the customer is treated.

**Strip allowances per rolling 90 days**

| Tier | Insulin-treated customer | Customer not treated with insulin | While the customer holds an active CGM program |
|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 450 | 150 | 150 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 600 | 200 | 150 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 300 | 100 | 300 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 300 | 100 | 300 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 450 | 100 | 150 |

The third column covers backup and confirmation testing while an active CGM program is held; the lower of that figure and the treatment-class allowance applies.

**Figures common to all six tiers**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Test strips per A4253 billing unit | 50 |
| Lancets per A4259 billing unit | 100 |
| Lancets covered per test strip covered | 1 |
| A4256 control solution covered per rolling 90 days | 1 unit |
| Least time between covered A4258 lancing devices | 6 calendar months from the ship date of the previous one |

**Above-allowance documentation recency**

| Tier | Practitioner record of testing frequency dated within, calendar months before the ship date |
|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 0 |
| All other tiers | 6 |

A quantity above the allowance is covered only with a practitioner record of the testing frequency dated within this many calendar months before the ship date; 0 means there is no above-allowance coverage on the tier.

**Unit arithmetic (hypothetical).** An allowance of 450 strips equals 9 billing units of 50 strips, and at 1 lancet per strip it carries 450 lancets, the content of four and a half lancet units of 100.
